# Document Attachment Clause

A root-local `Clause` that declares a document-context hook. Executable hooks and templates are read only from its admitted exact type.

- `hookAbi` is set to `document-context-1`, identifying the declared hook interface.
- `hookDefinition` is typed as `Compute Definition`.
- The inherited `parameters` and `bindings` are empty; no type-specific entries are declared.

The supplied definition does not establish what the hook computes, when it runs, or what effects it produces. Its name alone does not establish an attachment operation or confirm that a document has been attached.
